newsitem.title: GERMANY: GERMAN DATA DUE - regional CPI from Thursday.
newsitem.headline: GERMAN DATA DUE - regional CPI from Thursday.

text.p: Regional German consumer inflation data for April will be published from Thursday April 24, state statistics offices said on Monday.
Data on the cost of living in four states is used to calculate preliminary consumer inflation for west Germany, which is scheduled to be announced on April 25 or April 28.
The state of Hesse said it hoped to publish its data on Thursday. Baden-Wuerttemberg and North Rhine-Westphalia said their figures will come on Thursday at the earliest and probably on Friday.
Bavaria said it expected to report its data on Thursday or Friday.
In March, the west German consumer price index fell by 0.1 percent month-on-month and rose by 1.6 percent year-on-year.
The pan-German consumer price index fell by 0.2 percent month-on-month and rose by 1.5 percent year-on-year.
